row.select_when: h.phase = First and not (h.mode in {Leaf, Not})
row.inspected: deref(h.operandA): one value row (tag and scalar payload)

reads.bound: active(prog.constants) for Const, pre.active.data for Data

then.value: ScalarStaged::Selector{sel: if kind(a) = Bool then (if bool(a) then True else False) else NotBool}

template.eventKind: HelperEnter for .entry, HelperExit for .exit, HelperFail for .failure, HelperVisit otherwise
template.base_deltas: [-1, 1, 1, helperVisits, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] unless the row lists its own
template.cap_failure: for each kind in the row's cap_kinds_possible whose final delta is positive, in the fixed P6 order: Exhausted(kind), charged (P4 effects only); no write, no allocation-counter change, helperVisits unchanged; reg.helper, img.tasks, reg.taskLive and reg.result exactly as in the pre-image
template.preserved: reg.control, reg.controlOrigin, reg.envRoot, reg.depth, img.frames, reg.stackLimit, reg.initialFuel, reg.referenceCursor, every arena row below its pre-image active length, and every register or helper field not written by the row
template.erasure: an image with helper or result present erases to its legacy pre-state: drop reg.helper, reg.result, img.tasks and reg.taskLive; rows and value slots written during the interval are unreachable from legacy roots and ignored by decodeStep (rules.json:7323; interfaces.md:126)

schema_fields.UInt128: integer in [0, 2^128); bounded encoding is 16 little-endian bytes each in [0,255] (schema-types.json:30, 160-169); host representation u128
schema_fields.Nat: mathematical natural number (schema-types.json:47-49); no implicit host width. Host representation: usize for capacities, lengths and indices; u128 for work counters and fuel.

helper_common.parentResume: Opt<ResumeId> where ResumeId is primitive_types.ResumeId (host carrier Option<usize>, always None in B-core; present/Some is C-INV and HostViolation SI-08; Muse R3-F01, D-35)

Scalar_state: S1 phase First; staged None; regA 0; any mode
S2 phase Second; staged None; mode in {Add, Sub, Mul, Lt}; kind(operandA) = UInt; regA = u128(operandA)
S3 phase Second; staged None; mode = Cons; kind(operandA) = UInt; regA 0
S4 phase Second; staged None; mode = Branch; kind(operandA) in {Leaf, Branch}; regA 0
S5 phase Done; mode in {Add, Sub, Mul}; staged U128Value or PrimError(code 10 or 11)
S6 phase Done; mode in {Lt, Not}; staged BoolValue or PrimError(11)
S7 phase Done; mode in {Cons, Branch, Leaf}; staged PendingNode(tag = mode) or PrimError(11)
S8 phase Done; mode = TestBool; staged Selector
S9 phase Done; mode = TestType; staged TypeTest

always: operandB present iff mode in {Add, Sub, Mul, Lt, Cons, Branch}; expected present iff mode = TestType; regA = u128(operandA) in phase Done iff mode in {Add, Sub, Mul, Lt} and kind(operandA) = UInt, else 0; taskLive = 0

machine_registers.reg.depth: Depth (logical frame count; equals the physical active length of img.frames)
machine_registers.reg.active.valueSlots: ActiveLen(img.valueSlots) (physical only; no logical counter, D-08R)
machine_registers.reg.taskLive: TaskCount (equals the physical active length of img.tasks)
machine_registers.reg.segBase: {active: {data, dataFields, env, valueSlots}, alloc: {dataNodes, dataFields, environmentCells}, consumedWork}; BOUNDARY RESERVED: all zero in B-core (SI-05); set only by a future canonical resume
